content: Aaradhya Verma contacted insurance agent Anjali Desai because her health policy (HP-2024-0478) was marked as expired, causing concern for her upcoming medical appointments. Anjali explained that the policy reached its one-year term end on August 31, 2026, and did not auto-renew. Anjali provided three options to reinstate coverage: renew the current 12-month plan, upgrade to a higher-benefit plan, or obtain a temporary short-term extension for up to three months, and offered assistance with the paperwork.

action_items: Customer to review renewal, upgrade, or temporary continuation options and inform the agent
Agent to assist with paperwork once the customer chooses an option
